attributes.board_name: New Mexico Counseling and Therapy Practice Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by mental-health professional associations (e.g. NBCC, AMFTRB, AATA, ATCB, IC&RC, NAADAC), other state mental-health/social work/psychology boards, sponsored by national/state mental-health associations, or approved by the NM Counseling and Therapy Practice Board; graduate coursework (1 semester hour = 15 CE); pro bono clinical work up to 20 credits (independent licensees)
rules.audit_note: Proof of all CE hours is submitted at renewal (CEU tally sheet); board may require more documentation and gives 30 days to make up disapproved hours.

topics.who: All licensees: ethics related to counseling/mental health
Licensees who are approved clinical supervisors

rules.notes: CE period Oct 1 of renewal year to Sept 30 of expiration year. Late renewal after Sept 30: $100 penalty; license expires if not renewed by Oct 31. Waiver request 60 days before renewal; one-time extension fee $300.
rules.rule_quote: Effective for the renewal period beginning October 1, 1997, 40 contact hours of continuing education approved by the New Mexico counseling and therapy practice board will be required to be documented during each two-year renewal period.
